title: Stage all twelve City Moments from semantic events and return automatically
prompt: Read README.md, AGENTS.md, docs/PILOT100_BACKLOG.md and the exact referenced imported design sections before editing. RULES-SPEC-v1.md is canonical for production mechanics: six-node Repair/Sabotage tracks, one-person crew votes, Route/Gate operations, deterministic powers and silent spectators. SCREEN-FLOW prototype 5/5 scores and hardcoded transitions are UX references only. Preserve historical T01–T10 APIs/tests; implement the new view version in new game-v1 modules instead of silently changing legacy five-mark boards or command parsers. Use black/charcoal/neutral-frost chrome and full-colour approved expressive content through semantic asset keys. Modal-first means the complete game background is uniformly blur/dim/desaturated and inert; the fixed platform banner dock remains mounted outside that game viewport. No visible accounts/login, telemetry, credentials, live Firebase, ad SDK or unreviewed asset downloads. Keep local presentation distinct from authority: clients display server/solo-engine phases and deadlines, never compute secret outcomes, choose timeout targets, advance multiplayer on a local clock or reveal another alignment. Use injected semantic media/ad/purchase ports; no direct SDK playback or billing calls from UI. Edit only ownership, use original fixtures, run scoped tests/lint/typecheck and npm run check. DOM tests use jsdom, explicit afterEach(cleanup), Vitest and current Testing Library. Report results and contract changes; do not commit, push, open PRs, deploy or spend on providers. Implement the typed CityMoment presentation renderer for all six Repair and six Sabotage nodes. Consume authoritative semantic event identity, not inferred score changes; resolve approved icon/title/copy/motion/audio/haptic/persistent effect from the shared registry. Ordinary events last1.0–1.6s, major events1.8–2.6s, match-ending events lead directly to Match End. Block game input during presentation, preserve the dock, emit semantic media feedback and collapse automatically without Continue. Use reusable rise-bloom/scan/shield/descend-impact/fog/implosion/signal-cut presets and Reduced Motion fallbacks; retain map/feed consequences supplied by authority.
acceptance: All twelve semantic event IDs select the exact title/icon/preset and persistent-consequence presentation, including Grid Failure fall/impact and Disconnect fracture.
Duplicate/replayed event delivery does not replay a completed moment, emit duplicate media cues or advance a server phase.
Presentation disables underlying input and returns automatically on its own visual timeline or routes terminal events into Match End, without confirmation CTAs.
Reduced Motion removes disruptive shake/fall/flash while retaining full-colour icon, text and semantic feedback; banner geometry remains stable.
designSections: MOMENT-SPEC-v0: Rule, Presentation duration, Required event catalog, Implementation contract
